newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm ahead of Greenspan address.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm ahead of Greenspan address.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds were mostly firmer in active trading on Wednesday, as the market awaited U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's address to the Senate, dealers said.
Alan Greenspan begins testifying before the Senate at 1500 GMT. MinFin bonds like Brady debt are heavily influenced by moves in the U.S. Treasury bond market.
